svg.text: V-22 · TSR requirement diagram · longitudinal envelope
TSR-201…TSR-208 of WP-S-02 with the FSRs they derive from, the elements that satisfy them, the mechanisms that cite them and the cases that verify them
The envelope shall reject every ACC_CONTROL (0x343) frame whose ACCEL_C…
exceeds a_max, where a_max is derived from the controllability of HE-03.1…03.3 on the reference vehicle…
ASIL C · SM LIM · per frame
The envelope shall reject every 0x343 frame whose ACCEL_CMD is below a_min,
derived from the controllability of HE-04.1 (following traffic). Baseline a_min = −3.5 m/s² (raw −3500).
ASIL B · SM LIM · per frame
While longitudinal authority is not granted (not engaged, or accelerator pressed…
TSR-305), the envelope shall accept 0x343 only with the inactive acceleration value.
ASIL C · SM GATE · per frame
The envelope shall reject 0x343 frames whose ACCEL_CMD increases, relative to
the last accepted value (the inactive value counting as 0 m/s² at engagement), faster than j_up, derived fr…
ASIL C · SM LIM · per frame
The envelope shall reject 0x343 frames whose ACCEL_CMD decreases
(deceleration onset) faster than j_down, derived from following-traffic controllability.
ASIL B · SM LIM · per frame
On revocation of longitudinal authority the transition to SS-G shall not cause a
vehicle deceleration or acceleration step beyond the jerk bounds of TSR-204/205. If the PCM response to…
ASIL C · SM FR · react ≤ 0.3 s to SS-G start
For 0x343, the envelope shall also check the actuation-relevant fields
PERMIT_BRAKING, CANCEL_REQ, RELEASE_STANDSTILL and ACCEL_CMD_ALT against the values allowe…
ASIL C · SM GATE · per frame
The PCM shall bound ACC acceleration requests to its own ACC envelope, honour
CANCEL_REQ, and produce coasting without a deceleration step on the inactive value. (External measure.)
